title: Count Submatrices With Equal Number of Zeros and Ones
problemStatement: Given a binary matrix, determine the number of rectangular submatrices containing an equal number of 0s and 1s.
input: • First line contains N and M. • Next N lines each contain M binary integers.
constraints: • 1 ≤ N, M ≤ 300 • Matrix elements are either 0 or 1.
